question: Will the text return when the editor reopens?
example: Type the same phrase, “meeting at 2 pm”, into a simple editor in each case.
change: Both sessions end the same way. Only one writes the phrase to a file before closing.

nodes.title: Kept in working memory
nodes.body: The phrase exists only in the running editor. Closing it releases that memory. When the editor reopens, the phrase is gone.

nodes.title: Saved to a file
nodes.body: The editor writes the phrase to persistent storage, which keeps data after the program exits. Reopening the file brings the phrase back.

takeaway: To recover the phrase, the editor needs to write it before closing and read the file after reopening.
limit: Assume autosave is off, the save finishes and the file stays accessible. Recovering a deleted file would require a separate backup or recovery mechanism.
